paper: Trading-R1: Financial Trading with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored chronological contextual reward policy preserving Trading-R1's structured/evidence/decision curriculum, volatility-aware multi-horizon five-action labels, and asymmetric decision reward; not the unreleased Qwen3-4B checkpoint or native daily policy.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: An easy-to-hard curriculum first structures an investment thesis, then grounds claims in evidence, and finally aligns five-class trading decisions through outcome rewards.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 3.5 and Appendix S2, Algorithm S1
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Multi-horizon returns are volatility-normalized, combined with 0.3/0.5/0.2 weights, and discretized by asymmetric 3%, 15%, 53%, and 85% thresholds into Strong Sell through Strong Buy labels.
Group Relative Policy Optimization compares multiple candidate outputs for the same input using peer-normalized advantages without a separate value model.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Appendix S4, Stage III decision reward
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: A five-by-five reward matrix rewards exact and same-direction decisions while applying asymmetric penalties, especially to false bullish recommendations.

reasoning_stages.evidence_grounding: Use the three specialist scores, their consensus mean and dispersion, and all three pairwise interactions as an eight-dimensional evidence vector.
reasoning_stages.market_aligned_decision: Fit five separate reward regressions and choose the action with maximum predicted asymmetric reward after group-relative centering.

chronological_policy.reward_models: one chronological ridge model for each predicted action's asymmetric reward against the realized five-class truth
chronological_policy.group_relative_advantage: predicted action reward minus the five-action mean predicted reward for the same stock-month
chronological_policy.action_tie_breaking: first action in conservative Strong Sell-to-Strong Buy order
chronological_policy.continuous_score: action score plus 0.10 times tanh of the best-minus-second-best predicted reward margin
chronological_policy.label_quantile_policy: re-estimate asymmetric thresholds within each rolling training window only after all six-month labels have realized
chronological_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: frozen value-weighted long-short deciles with all six cost and missing-return paths

preserved_elements: multimodal technical, fundamental, and sentiment evidence
five Strong Sell through Strong Buy decisions
the complete printed five-by-five asymmetric decision reward matrix
group-relative comparison across multiple candidate actions
long-short interpretation of bullish and bearish actions
outcome rewards used only after their horizon has realized
approximated_elements: JKP specialist composites replace 20,000-30,000-token multimodal theses
numeric consensus and interactions replace natural-language evidence claims and citations
five ridge reward models replace Qwen3-4B SFT/RFT/self-distillation
cross-action reward centering replaces token-level GRPO advantages
the common monthly decile portfolio replaces the unspecified one-week action-to-weight execution
invented_elements: the exact JKP technical, fundamental, and sentiment feature groups
the 60-month policy window and six-month purge
past-only rolling quantile estimation rather than Algorithm S1's full-series quantiles
